notes.title: Partnership Announcement - Deep Dish Dungeon x Raw Fury
notes.content:
We are very excited to share that we have landed a publishing agreement with Raw Fury!

Our announcement trailer with the news was revealed at the Gamescom Awesome Indies showcase. Not only that, we're showing at Gamescom this year! 

This is the beginning of a very exciting journey and we can't wait to share it with you. We'll be posting news, dev updates, and more on Steam and across our social media channels:

[url=https://bsky.app/profile/beholdstudios.bsky.social]Bluesky[/url]
[url=https://www.instagram.com/beholdstudios]Instagram[/url]
[url=https://www.tiktok.com/@beholdstudios]Tiktok[/url]

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8bzFH3lxEX0

[h1]Deep Dish Dungeon in a nutshell![/h1]

Developed by Behold Studios, Deep Dish Dungeon is a dungeon crawler and exploration game that rewards curiosity and resourcefulness in an atmospheric environment.

In Deep Dish Dungeon, players will explore rooms and passageways solo or with up to three friends, and gather resources to improve their campsite. Players will be able to craft tools and cook nourishing meals to bolster strength throughout the journey, and unravel the enigma that lies within the shadows.

[list]
[*] [h3]Build, craft and cook[/h3] Forage and scavenge while traversing through the dungeon's bountiful depths. Between journeys, return to camp and plan next steps by the fire, and use resources to craft new tools and cook a hearty meal. Remember that food is progress: over time, unlock recipes that have different effects on stats.

[*] [h3]A massive dungeon to discover[/h3] Fortune favors the bold. Investigate every shadow, solve every puzzle, and open every door. The dungeon will reveal its secrets only with patience and persistence. Learn how to defeat enemies with diverse behaviors, discover coveted treasures, and never take a hint for granted.

[*] [h3]Explore together[/h3] Any adventure is better with pals! Play with up to three friends and collaborate to unveil the secrets of the dungeon.
[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2871520/Deep_Dish_Dungeon/?beta=0

notes.title: Full Release - Patch Notes - v0.9.76 to v0.9.89
notes.content:
Hey everyone!
We finally made it! With this update, Cosplay Club is now fully playable from start to the epic final boss battle!

It’s been a wild five-year journey, and we couldn’t have done it without you. Your support has meant the world to us, especially through all the ups and downs—studio changes, the pandemic, health challenges, and the loss of loved ones. Knowing you were out there, cheering us on, kept us going when things got tough.

We poured our hearts into this game, and we hope you love the complete experience. We can't wait to hear your thoughts, see your reactions, and watch how you take on the final boss!

Thank you for being with us every step of the way. You are truly the best community we could ask for.

Cheers!
Behold Studio's Team

notes.title: Full Controller Support!
notes.content:
Hey Everyone! Here is our monthly fix and a whole new feature, now we support gamepad and controllers. Our final step to also port the game to other platforms.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42942929/2156de578559fe3932a6194b7d288b84daa7d2e3.png[/img]

With this update, we took our time to revisit ***every*** interface in the game to ensure we could provide you with the best controller experience. As we are a very small team, this process was quite demanding because it required extensive testing. Nevertheless, we did our best because we believe this is a step in the right direction to create a better experience and to enable the game to be ported to consoles, hopefully, as quickly as possible.

notes.title: New update! Tons of fixes and improvements
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42942929/c5e7427ea58fc22558dc21e904506486f40134c3.png[/img]

In this patch, we have a multitude of fixes, updates, and even new content! However, we want to convey an important message to you to prevent any potential misunderstandings:

Regarding some of these changes, especially the new additions, if you have already played through some specific parts you won’t be able to access it in this save file. If you want to guarantee the access of these stuff and to experience our fixes in the early game progression you need to create a new game and start over. We are trying to make it more fun and enjoyable right at the start! 

We understand that these situations are not optimal, and rest assured, we always try to avoid them at all costs. However, they are necessary from time to time to enhance early experiences.

We hope you can all understand and appreciate the effort we’re putting into the game. ❤️

[list]
[*] Now you can battle against some massive bully mech-hands.
[*] New unlockables for your room! Can you collect all the toys? Find their quests!
[*] Game Difficulty Settings now offer additional options, helping with the game accessibility.
[*] - Beware! The highiest difficulty is.... high. We'll still be monitoring and refining it.
[*] Goddess booths now have dev-ine protection against rogue robots.
[*] Added more interactions with multiple objects around the convention center.
[*] Added new Wait-type Skills for you to mess around with.
[*] Added simple animations in many booths to help the game feel less static.
[*] Added area of effect skill preview for the Enemy Tank and Enemy Hand.
[*] Fixed a major issue causing inconsistent UI behaviour for the Next Objetive HUD, it feels good to know why and where you're headed.
[*] Fixed an issue where some Quests wouldn't start at the right time, like the Cardboard Hoarder Quest, for example.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Shop UI wouldn't function correctly in certain resolutions.
[*] Fixed an issue where Enemy Hand would cast vanish and prematurely end battles in the first round.
[*] Fixed an issue where the vSync settings wasn't saving properly.
[*] Fixed an issue where having more than 16 items in your inventory would break the system... ??
[*] Fixed an issue with some hats' pivot points to make them easier to attach to the head.
[*] Fixed an issue with the Summon Unity Haste visual.
[*] Updated the initial number of available shoes in the game.
[*] Updated Enemy Ranged Sci Fi visuals.
[*] Updated Enemy Cosplayer #20 visuals.
[*] Updated Toy Convention Contest type.
[*] Updated Crafting UI for better readability.
[*] Updated Galaxy Shop.
[*] Updated Rahul Shop.
[*] Updated Emma Shop.
[*] Updated Challenge Carnival Quests.
[*] Updated Pin Catalogue pin's order by type.
[*] Updated the minimum font size in the Event Planner UI for better readability.
[*] Updated NPC Portraits with new faces.
[*] Localization Fixes and Updates:
[*] - Crafting UI
[*] - Player Skills
[*] - Default Blueprints Models: This was causing the default blueprints to not work in other languages.
[*] - Cleaned up multiple texts to avoid artifacts caused by hidden characters.
[*] And much more!
[/list]

notes.title: Cosplay Club - Early Access Dec 14th!
notes.content:
Hey all!

We're happy to annouce that this next Dec 14th we'll be launching our game [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1172180/Cosplay_Club/]Cosplay Club[/url] on Early Access, here on Steam. 

A couple of weeks ago, our Kickstarter backers received access to the first chapter of the game and have been enjoying it so far. Because of that immediate good response, we decided to let you all be envolved with its development through the Early Access program. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1172180/Cosplay_Club/

[h1]Why Early Access?
[/h1]
We've chosen to release Cosplay Club through Early Access to involve our community in the game's development journey. We aim to gather valuable feedback, insights, and suggestions that will help us refine and enhance the gaming experience. This collaborative approach allows us to build a game that resonates with the preferences and expectations of you all. It all started during the Kickstarter in 2022, and we want to continue exploring this path.

The duration of the Early Access phase will depend on the feedback and input we receive from you all. We are committed to delivering a polished and engaging experience, and the Early Access period will continue until we feel that the game has reached a level of quality and completeness that aligns with our vision. It will be mostly around 9 to 12 months, and even after that, we plan to continue to integrate new content.

The Early Access version serves as a foundation, offering players the core mechanics and features of Cosplay Club. Throughout the Early Access phase, we plan to introduce new content, refine gameplay elements based on player feedback, and address any identified issues.

[h1]New game's name
[/h1]
From now on, we'll be refering to our game as [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1172180/Cosplay_Club/]Cosplay Club[/url]. We wanted a more friendly and catchy name, and funny enough everyone was already calling it by this name. So it makes even more sense to change it permanentely. But we all know how important the Mahou Senshi part is to us and to the game's theme, so it will be forever on our history.

[h1]We're here because of you!
[/h1]
Let's not forget how important is your collaboration in this project. Because of you we manage to get where we are, and we are finally able to make this game available to everyone else. Thank you very much for being part of our community!

[h1]Join our Discord
[/h1]
More than ever, [url=http://discord.gg/beholdstudios]our discord server[/url] will serve as a hub for everyone in the community. We'll be talking about the early access builds, patch updates, the content milestones, and everything else. Let's share some costumes over there!

[u][b]See you soon on Dec 14th![/b][/u]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1172180/Cosplay_Club/

notes.title: Developers of Chroma Squad are once again back on the Kickstarter with a new RPG project
notes.content:
[url=http://www.playcosplayclub.com][img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4653571/c3d54b91cb0e4e5fde2346796046b79a9541fe6c.png[/img][/url]

Our studio is back to the Kickstarter! We just revealed our new crowdfunding project and we're hoping to have the same success that we had in 2013 with Chroma Squad. Do you remember the manager RPG about Power Rangers and TV Show?

“Getting back to the Kickstarter once again is not for the faint-hearted. Chroma Squad in 2013 was a huge undertaken, but it was a very successful one.” said Saulo Camarotti, the lead creator of the studio. “Today we’re getting back to crowdfunding, but we want to bring more experience and maturity to the project” he completes.

The new project is called Mahou Senshi Cosplay Club, where the studio is focusing in creating a story driven RPG with their very well-known twist of mixing realities of imagination and meta reference. This time a Magical Girl gets her power from starting a journey in becoming a Cosplayer, and the game will allow you to create costumes and fight in turn-based battles using the costumes you create.

The game features a complete RPG set in a cosplaying world. You’ll have the opportunity to explore events and exhibitions to participate in cosplaying contests. Through exploration, you will expand your inventory with new materials and design parts so you can be more creative on crafting new costumes.

We're looking for support to complete the game on Kickstarter and we've put some interesting options in the pledge list, such as buying access to an early playable build of the game, or even becoming an NPC cosplayer inside the game that looks just like you and would be wearing a nice cosplay of your choice.

Mahou Senshi Cosplay Club will be heading first to PC and Major Consoles, and it is expected to release in 2023 upon the success of the Kickstarter. If you want to check out their crowdfunding page, please go to [url=http://www.playcosplayclub.com]http://www.playcosplayclub.com[/url].

[url=http://www.playcosplayclub.com][img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4653571/29be6f5339c2fbadb914e6789e9e39d621db5815.gif[/img][/url]

Behold Studios was founded in 2009 and is known for games like Knights of Pen & Paper, Chroma Squad and Out of Space. With more than 70 international awards and nominations the studio has gathered a big loyal community with their quirky pixel art RPGs along the years.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1172180/Mahou_Senshi_Cosplay_Club/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1172180/Mahou_Senshi_Cosplay_Club/[/url]
